decisions.rationale: Real exercised MVC producers close CopyOnWriteList over IValueProviderFactory, a reference interface, even when storing an already-boxed struct factory. No material shipping value-type T producer established. Concrete helper-only divergent IEquatable<T> witnesses demonstrate conditional comparer-contract differences, not a shipping MVC incompatibility or complete absence proof.
